in_sanskrit.name: Savani
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: श्वेताकर्षणा (श्वेता = white, कर्षणा = one who nourishes), शवनी = One who nourishes like white jasmine.

in_hindi.name: सवानी
in_hindi.long_meaning: सवानी = One who nourishes, supports or sustains like a river or a tree.

in_tamil.name: சவானி
in_tamil.long_meaning: சவானி = One who nourishes or supports, derived from the Tamil word 'சவான்' (Chavan), meaning river.

in_telugu.name: సవాని
in_telugu.long_meaning: సవాని = One who nourishes or supports, derived from the Telugu word 'సవానము' (Savvānu), meaning river.

in_marathi.name: Savani
